name: NetBird
title: netbird.io
shortDescription: NetBird is an open source platform that leverages WireGuard-based networking combined with Zero Trust Network Access. It's designed for teams needing secure, reliable connectivity without complex setups. Typical users include IT departments and remote teams, facilitating secure access to internal resources from various devices and locations. An example use case is a company enabling remote employees to access internal tools securely and efficiently.
pros: Easy to set up and manage
Supports a wide range of devices and platforms
Open source with flexible deployment options
cons: Requires technical knowledge for initial setup
Dependent on the security of underlying technologies like WireGuard
Limited brand recognition compared to established VPN solutions
